summary: Maison Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a Formation, Subscription and Software Contribution Agreement dated July 22, 2026. The company, through wholly owned subsidiary AZLL LLC, will form a new Hong Kong entity, Maison AI Limited, to develop AI software for grocery retail. AZLL will subscribe for 200 of 222 shares (90.09%) in exchange for contributing its Drem and WSYQR software systems valued at $2,000,000. Two external cash subscribers, Hangzhou Shengxianbao and Yiwu Yanghan, each subscribe for 11 shares (4.96%) for $110,000, payable in six monthly installments. Closing is subject to conditions, including execution of a shareholders agreement, with termination if not closed by March 31, 2027. This is a business formation and contribution arrangement, not a special-situation corporate event.
